recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a man sitting on a white bed against a pale blue wall, characterized by a heavy cyan/blue color cast and high-contrast lighting. The composition is balanced by a black hat in the lower left and a horizontal line of geometric, lowercase text in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark clothing of the subject anchors the center against a bright, desaturated background.
The horizontal text line aligns with the subject's shoulder height, creating a stable horizon.
The blue tint unifies the white bedding, skin tones, and background into a cohesive cool atmosphere.
coreInvariants: High-key background with deep black shadows in clothing
Lowercase geometric typography with wide letter spacing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, captured from the waist up, filling approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark sunglasses and black blazer provide the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves left to the typography, then down to the hat in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of pale blue wall and white rumpled bedding provide breathing room around the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across all hues except for the deep blacks; high value contrast between the subject and the environment.
paletteRestrictions: No warm tones (reds, oranges, yellows) except for very muted skin undertones.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'a' is a single-story circle with a vertical stem
The letter 'm' and 'n' have sharp, right-angled shoulders

composition.scale: Small to medium relative to frame
composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the negative space of the wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with a graphic separator (like a cross or vertical bar).
graphicDevices: Thin vertical/horizontal cross element separating words

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square-geometric feel of the era.
Provides the wide, technical, mid-century modern look.
Similar square-off curves and clean aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man with dark hair and sunglasses wearing a black blazer over a white striped shirt, sitting on a rumpled white bed. The background is a plain pale blue wall. Apply a strong cyan-blue color grade to the entire image, desaturating skin tones. Place a black fedora hat in the bottom left foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of lowercase geometric sans-serif text in the upper left. Use wide tracking. Include a thin white cross-like symbol between the first two words.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly cool-toned?
Is there a clear contrast between the black clothing and the white bedding?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color cast
Amount of rumple in the bedding
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos on the clothing or hat
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Professional studio lighting with soft shadows

postGenerationChecks: Text is legible and horizontally aligned.
The blue tint is consistent across the whole frame.
The subject's pose feels relaxed yet structured.
Negative space is preserved in the top half of the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Cool Blue Grade + Geometric Lowercase Typography + Minimalist Interior
